title: Injectivity of a normalized affine conormal lift
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset S$ be affine opens with $U\subset f^{-1}V$. Set $A=\Gamma(X,U)$ and $R=\Gamma(S,V)$, with ring map induced by $f$. Let $C$ be the actual diagonal conormal [def-sc-diagonal-conormal], and let $D:\mathcal O_X\to C$ satisfy the normalization of [lem-sc-diagonal-conormal-derivation-exists]. For every $A$-linear map $e:\Omega_{A/R}\to\Gamma(U,C)$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] such that $e(\mathrm da)=D_U(a)$ for all $a\in A$, the map $e$ is injective. No surjectivity is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08S2 (lemma-differentials-diagonal), final affine calculation; Tags 01R3 (lemma-affine-conormal), 01KJ and 00RW; read online 2026-10-13

proof.text: Set A = Γ(X,U), R = Γ(S,V), with algebra structure from f.appLE, and W = p₁⁻¹U ∩ p₂⁻¹U. The diagonal identities give U ⊆ Δ⁻¹W. Apply diagonalConormal_affine_ideal_class_core to obtain tensor ring coordinates r, the two projection formulas, and lifts of every multiplication-kernel element to an actual kernel section. Apply diagonalConormal_affine_ideal_class_q in these same coordinates to obtain an A-linear cotangent equivalence c with its tensor-pullback-unit formula.

For a in A, take j = 1 ⊗ a - a ⊗ 1 in the multiplication ideal. Choose its kernel section s using the core lemma. Ring-map additivity and the projection formulas identify the inclusion of s with p₂*(a) - p₁*(a). The unit formula for c and the normalization hD give c(da) = D(a), because Mathlib identifies da definitionally with the cotangent class of j. This is the same as e(da) by he.

Apply Mathlib CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext to the ModuleCat morphisms corresponding to e and c.toLinearMap. Their equality on every da gives equality of morphisms, hence equality of underlying linear maps. Replace e by c.toLinearMap and use c.injective. No surjectivity of e or generation theorem for actual conormal sections is needed.

theorem diagonalConormal_affine_lift_injective (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (D : (diagonalConormal f).val.Derivation' f.pullbackPresheafToPresheaf)
    (hD : IsDiagonalConormalDerivation f D)
    (e : CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV) →ₗ[Γ(X, U.1)]
      Γ(diagonalConormal f, U.1))
    (he : ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), e (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) =
      D.d (X := op U.1) a) : Function.Injective e
